_comment: Template for resource JSON files. Use this structure for new providers. Replace placeholders with actual values. Top-level: name (string), icon (string), totalResources (number), categories (object). Categories: name (string), path (string), resources (array of objects). Resources: name (string), file (string), type (string), optional: hasWhiteVariant (boolean), format (string). File paths should match public/resources/{provider}/{category}/{resource}.png or .svg.
name: Provider Name
